correctness.rationale: For each coordinate, two independent uniformly drawn binary vertices disagree with probability 2c(N-c)/N^2. The order and chain one-counts are a and b. The two inequalities b<=a and b<=N-a follow respectively from maximality and injective deletion of maximal elements. Their exact equality cases are maximal and minimal poset elements, yielding the coordinate gap and global strictness. Analytic all-poset proof plus 33,867 exact-integer small-poset checks and the explicit oblique counterexample. No claim of infinite proof from finite checks.
